title: Per-setup daily loss limit that counts open-lot risk (realized R + open lots x 1R <= -2R blocks new entries), vs the live realized-only -2R limit and no limit
hypothesis: The live per-setup limit (ledger 2026-10-20-twin-cap-setup-loss) checks realized R only, so a setup that opens 3-9 lots in a few polls loses far more than 2R before it trips. Day 1 (2026-10-20): 6 Testing 1 and 4 Testing 2 setups tripped; final live R after costs -2.06 to -8.88R against the -2R line. The overshoot came from lots already open at the trip: heat_fade_short-FD 9 open lots -3.36R, MF3-open-flowsell-rsi5hi-FD 4 lots -3.54R, MF1-945-flowsell-vwapup-FD 3 lots -2.92R, MF5-flowsell-vwapup-rsi5hi-FD 6 lots -1.61R; RW2-exhaustion-noon-adv150-short-FD (T2) had -7.46R realized at the trip because 6 lots opened 10:12-10:17 while realized R was still about -0.2R. At the same time the signals the limit blocked were net positive in Testing 1 (what-if run, production costs: 73 signals, 66% win, +18.87R, about +$209; MF1-FD alone +14.49R over 21 signals on the 10:40-11:00 rally) and negative in Testing 2 (14 signals, -4.86R, about -$39). So the realized-only limit both overshoots and cuts setups at their local low.
notes: One session, in-sample, descriptive (0 backtest configurations; what-if R is the runner's own simulation of skipped signals, net of the config/default.yaml cost model). Pre-declare on history2y, per account book: (A) no per-setup limit, (B) realized-only -2R (live), (C) realized + open-lot risk -2R, (D) C at -3R, (E) cap on lots open per setup per poll (2/3) instead of a limit; score day-level P/L, worst setup-day, regime split up/down, walk-forward, try-count-scaled t (N=6). Locked block 2024-11-01..2025-02-28 untouched until a finalist exists. Educational only - not financial advice.

title: Setup Generator 'hold' (no-target, flat at 15:55) setups: score a 1R target / 1R-activated trail variant alongside the hold exit in the generator's own validation
hypothesis: GEN-261020-07 (RSI slope up, long lower wick, ATR% >= 4.4, AM, hold-long) opened 5 longs 10:05-10:26 (KTOS, NTSK, QXO, RDW, SBET). Entry slippage averaged 25 bps (RDW 59 bps). The generator's hold exits may be scored on bars that do not show this intraday round trip in small, volatile names.
